# TinySoundFont

`tsf.h` is vendored unchanged from [schellingb/TinySoundFont](https://github.com/schellingb/TinySoundFont)
at commit `853a0a171759f1ddba0de1442133a75912bbeffa`.
It provides the SoundFont synthesizer for Doom's MUS music. Its MIT license is
preserved in the header and in `TinySoundFont.LICENSE`.

TimGM6mb instrument data is downloaded separately from Debian, with its original
copyright notice. It is GPL-2 licensed and is not bundled in Git.
